tipsWindow.title: Welcome
tipsWindow.heading: Welcome to Sable
tipsWindow.tipTools: Tools live on the left strip — press a letter (B brush, V move, M marquee…) to switch; press it again to cycle the group; HOLD it for a temporary tool.
tipsWindow.tipCanvas: Navigate with the mouse wheel (zoom at cursor), middle-drag (pan), 0 (fit) and 1:1 in the status bar. Press ` for the quick radial tool menu.
tipsWindow.tipLayers: Everything is a layer on the right: paint layers, adjustments, live filters, groups and masks. Drag rows to reorder or nest.
tipsWindow.tipNonDestructive: Adjustments and filters never touch your pixels — change or remove them any time, and hold \ to compare before/after.
tipsWindow.tipShortcuts: The full shortcut list is in Help, and every command shortcut can be rebound in Preferences.
tipsWindow.tipAi: Optional on-device AI (background removal, smart select, upscale, generative fill) can be enabled in Preferences.

toolStatus.move: Drag to move (Shift = axis). Handles scale (Shift = free, Ctrl = from centre). Top handle rotates (Shift = snap 15°). Alt-drag a corner = perspective.
toolStatus.marquee: Drag to select. Shift adds, Alt subtracts, Shift+Alt intersects. Drag the interior to move the selection.
toolStatus.lasso: Drag to draw a freehand selection. Shift adds, Alt subtracts, Shift+Alt intersects.
toolStatus.polyLasso: Click to place points; click the first point or press Enter to close, Esc to cancel. Shift adds, Alt subtracts.
toolStatus.magicWand: Click a colour to select contiguous pixels. Shift adds, Alt subtracts, Shift+Alt intersects.
toolStatus.colorRange: Click a colour to select all similar pixels. Shift adds, Alt subtracts.
toolStatus.brush: Drag to paint. Alt samples a colour. Ctrl+Alt-drag adjusts size/hardness. [ / ] resize.
toolStatus.eraser: Drag to erase. Ctrl+Alt-drag adjusts size/hardness.
toolStatus.fill: Click to flood-fill with the foreground colour. Alt samples a colour.
toolStatus.gradient: Drag to draw a gradient (start → end). Shift constrains the angle.
toolStatus.crop: Drag a rectangle, then Enter to commit or Esc to cancel.
toolStatus.shape: Drag to draw the shape. Set fill/stroke/sides in the options bar; edit it later in the Shape panel.
toolStatus.shapeLine: Drag to draw. Shift constrains the angle.
toolStatus.cloneStamp: Alt-click to set the source, then drag to paint cloned pixels.
toolStatus.heal: Alt-click to set the source, then drag to heal (source texture, matched to the destination tone).
toolStatus.spotHeal: Drag over a blemish to heal it from a nearby region (no source click needed).
toolStatus.patch: Make a selection, then drag it over a clean area to patch (tone-matched).
toolStatus.liquify: Drag to push pixels. Choose Push/Bloat/Pucker/Twirl + strength in the options bar.
toolStatus.meshWarp: Drag the grid points to deform the layer. Enter applies, Esc cancels.
toolStatus.dodge: Drag to lighten. Adjust strength in the options bar.
toolStatus.burn: Drag to darken. Adjust strength in the options bar.
toolStatus.sponge: Drag to desaturate. Adjust strength in the options bar.
toolStatus.blurBrush: Drag to blur. Adjust strength in the options bar.
toolStatus.sharpenBrush: Drag to sharpen. Adjust strength in the options bar.
toolStatus.smudge: Drag to smudge colour along the stroke.
toolStatus.type: Click to place a text layer, then type. Double-click existing text to edit.
toolStatus.pen: Click to add corner nodes; drag to pull smooth handles. Click the first node or press Enter to finish, Esc to cancel.
toolStatus.node: Drag a node or handle to reshape the selected path. Click the path to add a node. Alt-click a node to delete it.
toolStatus.eyedropper: Click to sample a colour. Use the options bar to set the sample size.
toolStatus.hand: Drag to pan. (Space-drag pans with any tool; wheel zooms.)
toolStatus.zoom: Click to zoom in, Alt-click to zoom out. Wheel zooms to the cursor.

settingsWindow.clickAShortcutThenPress: Click a shortcut, then press the key combination. Backspace clears it; Reset restores the default. Tool letters (B/V/M…) and navigation keys are fixed.
